paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Tanchuma Yashan on Behar, and in the Tanchuma of Buber the reading is Bar Gedalya.[^1]

notes.text: Bar Guria and Bar Gedalya remain the two readings Hyman attributes to the Tanchuma texts. No section in Behar or locus in Buber is added, no fresh collation is claimed, and the edition descriptions are not silently collapsed. The heading title remains R'.
